Note (G1): We report the Xth percentile of the estimated posterior of quantity 
           Y as P_X_[Y]. For each emission line we also report limiting fluxes 
           computed directly as 3 times the standard deviation of the specific 
           flux in the featureless regions of the spectra near each emission 
           line of interest, holding the shape of the line fixed 
           (F_lim_ = 3{sigma}_F{lambda}_(2{pi}*l)^0.5^, where l is the 
           best-fit width of the emission line).
Note (1): As measured from the standard deviation of the spectrum on either 
          side of the line of interest.
